title: Physical assignment and initial check
caption: All 72 positive vehicle OD pairs load 953.0498427 PCE in the one-hour engineering scenario onto a 2,150-link graph; 670 physical links have positive flow. Maps retain all frozen GMNS road vertices, with a one-to-one link-ID join and no summed serial-segment flow. Flow widths, v/c, and travel times come from the same saved link table. Only the initial assignment check is recorded: gap 1.6551133727449009e-15 against 1e-4, with zero FW updates. Known restriction from-ways were conservatively removed, so this is not a complete turn-aware representation. Map attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
unit: PCE per declared hour; dimensionless v/c; minutes; dimensionless relative gap
transformation: Replace node-to-node chords with frozen S0 GMNS road geometry from the accepted R3 map, keeping every road vertex.
Join model_link_id to link_id one-to-one; assert all 2,150 IDs and flow values match; draw no virtual arcs.
Use longitude/latitude aspect 1/cos(mean latitude); no geometry cropping or stretching.
Line width = 0.45 + 2.1 sqrt(flow/max flow), positive links only over neutral all-link context.
Use original 16 travel-time histogram bins; export counts/edges.
Draw one actual initial gap point and frozen threshold; no synthetic iteration.

Canonical SVG presentation-only transform: append an explicit DejaVu Serif, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif fallback rule for text and tspan with !important; no font binaries, geometry, numeric labels, PNG pixels or source SVG bytes changed.
source_record_sanitization: Original evidence retained in private snapshot; derived record contains logical IDs and SHA-256 only.
